# CSOAI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence
The sovereign AI governance OS. Measurement, attestation and instruments for AI safety. Free open-source base; full managed stack on Pro.

## Consumer world
The consumer AI world (characters, hatch, memory, play) lives at [meok.ai](https://meok.ai).

## For agents
Full rundown for inspection/testing: AGENTS.md in the repo. Live reasoning + signing API: https://os.meok.ai/api (/chat, /govern, /orchestrate, /health, /systemcard, /sign, /verify — keyless, verify offline). 30+ open-source governed MCP tools at github.com/CSOAI-ORG.

## Org
CSOAI Ltd (UK). MIT-licensed core. EU AI Act Article 50 transparent.

## Canonical facts (2026-08-01)
- CSOAI = Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence (CSOAI Ltd, UK).
- CSOAI is a measurement body, not a certification or accreditation body. It issues signed, provision-anchored measurement records — not accredited certification.
- GSPC = Governance · Safety · Provenance · Continuity — the four measurement axes.
- corpus-watch re-hashes 127 provisions across 4 instruments daily (EU AI Act, UK GDPR, DPA 2018, NIS2-UK). Public: github.com/CSOAI-ORG/corpus-watch.
- EU AI Act Article 50 main transparency obligations apply from 2 Aug 2026.
- Every published number traces to a signed artefact; design targets are labelled DESIGN, measured results MEASURED.
- UNMEASURED never counts as a fail — an unreachable lane or coverage gap is reported honestly, with its n and its limits.

## Measurement surfaces (2026-08-01)
- /training-board.html — living training + attestation board (staging, DESIGN-labelled): role-based training measured against the live regulatory corpus; XP, seasons, CASA tier readiness; signed living attestation records that go STALE when corpus-watch detects drift.
- /regulator-console.html — regulator oversight console (staging, DESIGN-labelled): provision watch (127 provisions, 4 instruments, daily re-hash), market sweep predicate scores, attestation registry, model care-floor standings. Oversight evidence, not certification.
- training_engine + regulator_console are open measurement instruments; every figure traces to a dated, signed artefact.
